opennyai_summary.11_January_2024__facts:
2. Apprehending his arrest, the applicant has approached this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail, in connection with Madhupur (Mahila) P.S. Case No.15 of 2020, corresponding to G.R Case No.262 of 2021, registered for the offence under Section 498A & 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M.,
Madhupur.
It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the O.P No.2 that the wife of the applicant has to undergo certain treatment on 14.01.2024.
opennyai_summary.11_January_2024__decision:
3. Both the parties, i.e, the appellant-husband and the O.P No.2/wife have shown willingness to resume their matrimonial life.
4. As a goodwill gesture, the applicant has paid an amount of Rs.11,000/- (Rs. Eleven Thousand) in cash to the O.P No.2/wife.
The applicant has promised that he will take his wife along with children on 14.02.2024.
6.
Considering the above fact, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail provisionally to the applicant for three months.
Accordingly, the applicant is directed to surrender in the court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender, the court below shall enlarge the applicant on bail on his furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M., Madhupur in connection with Madhupur (Mahila) P.S. Case No.15 of 2020 corresponding to G.R Case No.262 of 2021.
7.
Accordingly, put up this case on 16.04.2024.

opennyai_summary.final__facts:
2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Madhupur (Mahila) P.S. Case
No.15/2020, corresponding to G.R. Case No.262/2021, registered for the alleged offence under
Section 498A, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the
Court of the learned S.D.J.M., Madhupur.
3. Vide order dated 11.01.2024, the petitioner was provided privilege of anticipatory bail
provisionally for three months.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
4.  Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the husband and in view of the order passed in the present A.B.A., the husband and wife, both are residing together and there is no difficulty.
He submits that the petitioner and opposite party no.2 are present in the Court.
5. Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 submits that the wife is residing along with the petitioner and children and they are living happy conjugal life in matrimonial house.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
Considering that the privilege of anticipatory bail was provided provisionally for three months and the petitioner has already furnished bail bond in terms of the order dated 11.01.2024 and in view of that, the provisional bail granted to the petitioner vide order dated 11.01.2024 is, hereby,
confirmed.
7. Since the petitioner has already furnished the bail bond, he will be allowed to remain on same bail bond.
8. Accordingly, this application is disposed of.
